description: A slab of brushed titanium sitting under the Chromavision on its own machined shelf, no bigger than a hardback and considerably heavier. The loading door does not have a catch — you offer it a cassette and it takes it from you, draws it in over about four seconds, and closes without a sound. A single amber bar reports what it is doing. Polaris sold these to people who owned exactly one film and wanted it treated properly.
name: Polaris Executive Cassette Theatre
